text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae got injured, so I brought her to the nurse's office, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: You're okay, so let's rest quietly for a while.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I just don't want to show anything pathetic to the people who believe in me...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let's start rehab right away! I'll overcome this with pure guts, you'll see...!
choice_data_list: You need to rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
In that case, I'll recover quickly through sheer willpower...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, it didn't heal right away, and Hokko Tarumae was forced to take it easy until she made a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I do have experience starting from the bottom, so
leave judging that sort of thing to me."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—...I'm, so sorry...
...I rushed and seem to have misjudged things.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll focus
on healing my injury after all...
And so, Hokko Tarumae had to take a break and rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Looks like the injured spot doesn't hurt at all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What matters most after all is a never-give-up spirit...! I'll have to try even, even harder!
Hokko Tarumae overcame her injury through sheer grit, making her comeback a remarkably smooth one.
